Earn positive Review cards by satisfying the Architect , Decorator , and Mystery Guests , while hiding or covering negative stars. The player with the most points wins. Setup Choose a Scenario. Place the Scenario where all players can see it. Shuffle the Mystery Guest cards and place 2 face down below the Scenario. Sort the Review cards into five negative-star decks (-1 to -5). Prepare the Manor deck: 4 players: all cards. 3 players: remove cards marked "4". 2 players: also remove cards marked "3". Divide the Manor cards into 6 equal decks (one per round). Place the Vortex card to begin the discard pile. Each player receives: 1 Hall card 1 Architect track 1 Ghost token 1 Player Aid Each player secretly looks at one Mystery Guest and marks it with their Ghost token. Game Overview The game consists of 6 rounds . Each round every player places 2 Manor cards into their manor. During the game you will: Expand your manor. Progress toward Architect milestones. Reveal Mystery Guests. Earn and place Review cards. After Round 6: Inauguration Final Scoring Round Structure 1. Deal One player deals 3 Manor cards face down to every player. 2. Choice 1 Each player: Looks at their three cards. Chooses one. Places it face down in front of themselves. 3. Pass Cards From the remaining two cards: Pass one left. Pass one right. (2-player game: pass one to your opponent and discard the other.) 4. Place 1 Everyone simultaneously adds their chosen card to their manor. Resolve any effects. 5. Choice 2 Pick up the two received cards. Keep one. Discard the other to the Vortex. (Skip this step in a 2-player game.) 6. Place 2 Everyone places their second chosen card. Resolve any effects. Repeat until all six rounds have been played. Placement Rules Every placed card must obey both rules: It must be placed on an empty space or directly on top of another Manor card. It must remain connected to your Hall through a continuous path. Hall cards and Review cards can never be covered. Connections Horizontal connections require matching openings between adjacent cards. Vertical connections use staircases or ladders. Only one complete staircase or ladder is needed between stacked cards. If a section becomes disconnected from the Hall: It cannot be used to connect future cards. It may become connected again later. During Inauguration all disconnected cards are discarded. Architect Progress Each Scenario defines an Architect objective. Examples include: Complete staircases Blocked vertical connections Whenever you reach a new milestone: Advance your Architect marker. Take the indicated Review card. Each milestone can only be claimed once. Eye Symbols Some Manor cards contain an Eye . When you place one: Reveal one Mystery Guest.
